global: A rich, amber miso ramen broth glistens in a dark bowl, topped with tender chashu pork slices and a crisp nori sheet. Menma bamboo shoots peek beneath, all set against a warm, softly lit wooden table.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle light reflections.
regions.bowl: Dark ceramic ramen bowl with glossy, uneven glaze and slightly irregular rim.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth, rich amber hue, glossy surface with fine foam, gently cradles noodles and toppings.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, rectangular, with a slightly curled edge and visible grainy surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slices show pinkish-red meat with white fat marbling, irregular shapes, and glossy surface from broth.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as golden-brown, slightly translucent, elongated strips with a fibrous, textured surface.
